notes: THE REGISTER CAN ONLY BE CHANGED THROUGH ITS OWN ACTIONS - a cheque's number, date or amount, a lodgement's amount, which cheque paid a remitted deduction and a posted payslip now move only through the actions that record why; everything the screens already do still works. A LODGEMENT'S AMOUNT can now be corrected properly while it is uncredited. A MATCHED STATEMENT LINE is checked against the register as it is marked, the bank's own figures can no longer be edited, and setting a line aside needs a reason. YOUR EARLIER BACKUPS CAN BE SEALED - a passphrase used to protect only backups taken after it; the Backup screen now encrypts the older ones too. THE DASHBOARD names five things it used to miss, including overdue staff advances. A PRINTED RECONCILIATION says which version it is and whether it was signed clean. Installing: no data changes and no ledger entries. Installs over the previous version - please still take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now. Full notes are on the download page.
